vectors.harness: For each probe, line(atMs, case) must equal the probe's line exactly.
vectors.rule: Times are ms from the send. Outside a load (before loadStartMs, from loadEndsAtMs on, or no load at all) the line is the thinking clock counted from the send: "thinking…" under 1 s, else "thinking… Ns" with N = floor(atMs / 1000). During a load, a load is a rebuild when no cache for the current bundle existed at its start, or from the moment a cache file is created or rewritten during it (rebuildSeenAtMs). An image-capable rebuild shows "preparing the model for images… this happens once" from that moment to the load's end. Any other load shows the thinking clock until quietMs after loadStartMs, then "loading the model…". "Cache present for this bundle" is each platform's own test; only the bool is shared.
